spine_alignment.course_governing_question: How can a finite stream of samples support a trustworthy claim about a physical signal and a reliable implemented system?
spine_alignment.spine_step: The DFT supplies finite coordinates and the FFT computes them efficiently; a DTMF receiver turns coefficients into a constrained decision.
spine_alignment.step_caption: Indexing, scaling, factorization, and latency meet in one receiver.
inherits: Sampling, Aliasing, and Reconstruction fixed omega=2*pi*f/f_s, made the sampling-rate declaration part of every hertz claim, and proved that a deterministic digital system cannot recover analog provenance after aliasing.

DFT Bins, Symmetry, and Scaling fixed the negative-sign unscaled forward DFT, natural bin order, real-input conjugate symmetry, and the distinction between a finite record's DTFT and its sampled DFT grid.

FFT Factorization and Machine Layout established that a full transform and selected sums can be compared coefficient-by-coefficient only on the same coordinates, with sign, scale, order, transform length, and operation units declared.

The repaired dtmf-v1 corpus supplies deterministic synthetic boundary fixtures, including a 20 ms mandatory non-operation case, a 25 ms indeterminate case, and 10 dB active-tone-SNR files; receiver-study.json now adds a frozen executable study whose held-out pass and failure verdicts must remain separate.
spine_alignment.open_problem: Finite frequency magnitudes do not yet specify when one low/high pair is valid, when evidence is ambiguous, how duration and latency are measured, or which coordinate-safe computation supplies the features.
spine_alignment.contributes: Design an auditable key-or-reject contract that keeps spectral coordinates, named-profile gates, temporal state, latency origins, and cost ledgers separate.
spine_alignment.handoff_boundary: This lesson exposes a rectangular-window weak-line masking failure and refuses a window choice. The next lesson owns main-lobe, sidelobe, coherent-gain, scalloping, and ENBW tradeoffs.

opening_verbatim_check.required: A DTMF receiver must turn finite Fourier evidence into a key-or-reject decision while keeping spectral features, temporal qualification, latency, and cost on declared coordinates.
opening_verbatim_check.planned_first_sentence: A DTMF receiver must turn finite Fourier evidence into a key-or-reject decision while keeping spectral features, temporal qualification, latency, and cost on declared coordinates.
exact_throughline_after_opening: <Ref lesson="fft-factorization-and-layout">FFT Factorization and Machine Layout</Ref> established that a full transform and selected sums are interchangeable only at the same declared coordinates, then handed their finite evidence to this application.

<Ref lesson="sampling-aliasing-and-reconstruction">Sampling, Aliasing, and Reconstruction</Ref> fixed the hertz-to-radians/sample map and the rule that a digital detector cannot undo analog spectral overlap.

The remaining task is to turn eight finite frequency measurements into an auditable stateful contract that emits a key only after every spectral and temporal gate passes; every failed or ambiguous gate emits `reject`.

read_through_join.immediate_predecessor_close_exact: The lesson has established exact radix-2 and mixed-radix evaluation, separate arithmetic ledgers, safe overwrite rules, and explicit order and scale checks. <Ref lesson="phone-channel-dtmf-receiver">Phone-Channel DTMF Receiver</Ref> next decides which finite frequency evidence is sufficient under offset, twist, channel response, thresholds, and latency.
read_through_join.reason: The target opening answers the predecessor's exact handoff: it treats the coefficients as evidence, not decisions, and names the missing spectral, temporal, latency, and cost contracts without re-teaching factorization.

retrieval_gate.placement: Immediately after the exact opening throughline and before the first new DTMF decision rule.
retrieval_gate.mode: Closed-book <Task> with one folded answer block; the four prompts are separated again later through body pairs and closing exercises rather than repeated immediately.

prompts.prompt: At f_s=8 kHz, map 770 Hz and 1336 Hz to radians/sample and state whether either nominal tone aliases across pi.
prompts.success_criterion: Computes omega_770=0.1925*pi and omega_1336=0.334*pi radians/sample; both lie strictly below pi, so neither nominal tone aliases at the declared rate.
prompts.later_spacing: Section 2 uses the same physical frequencies to distinguish exact-nominal projections from DFT-grid bins.

prompts.prompt: Write the course's raw forward N-point DFT and state the conjugate-symmetry relation for a real record.
prompts.success_criterion: Writes X[k]=sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]exp(-j2*pi*k*n/N), with no forward scale, and X[N-k]=conj(X[k]) away from self-conjugate endpoints.
prompts.later_spacing: Section 1 and closing exercise 3 use conjugate partners to refute a two-largest-bins classifier.

prompts.prompt: State the condition under which a selected physical-frequency sum C_N(f) is the same coordinate as one ordinary DFT bin X_N[k], and state what changes when 205 samples are zero-padded to length 256.
prompts.success_criterion: Requires f/f_s congruent to k/N modulo one under the same record and scale; padding changes the sampled grid to k*f_s/256 but does not add observed samples or narrow the record-window response.
prompts.later_spacing: Section 2, body pair 1, and closing exercise 5 require the coordinate identity before any cost comparison.

prompts.prompt: Distinguish analog aliasing from finite-record leakage by naming when each is created and one change that can affect it.
prompts.success_criterion: Aliasing is created at sampling when analog replicas overlap and requires an acquisition-rate or analog anti-alias change; leakage is created by finite observation/windowing and changes with the record/window, not by post hoc relabeling as an analog alias.
prompts.later_spacing: The final section and the only forward exercise expose leakage and hand its repair to the window lesson.

retrieval_gate.pass_rule: Proceed when R3 is correct and at least two of R1, R2, and R4 are correct. A miss on R3 routes to the predecessor's final selected-sums exercise; a miss on R1/R4 routes to the sampling lesson's hertz map and irreversibility KeyFacts; a miss on R2 routes to the DFT convention recap.

argument_skeleton.heading: A pair becomes a candidate only through two frequency groups
argument_skeleton.running_question: What structure turns raw spectral magnitudes into a possible DTMF symbol without forcing every input to a key?
argument_skeleton.seam_sentence_contract: The inherited transforms return coefficients, but a DTMF decision begins with a stricter combinatorial condition than selecting two large values.
argument_skeleton.concrete_entry: Draw the original rights-safe 4-by-4 grid, highlight key 5 as 770 Hz plus 1336 Hz, then put a lone 770 Hz tone and two low-group tones on an explicit reject branch.
argument_skeleton.claim: Exactly one accepted low-group component and exactly one accepted high-group component define only a candidate key; every missing, duplicate, same-group, or ambiguous case is reject.
required_apparatus: The four-prompt retrieval gate before new content
Original DTMF row/column grid with key 5 and a visible reject branch; no copied ITU artwork
Concrete real-signal conjugate-pair and lone-tone leakage counterexamples before the formal decision definition
Definition of the key-or-reject mapping only after those examples
argument_skeleton.expectation_reversal: The two largest magnitudes need not be the two transmitted tones: over all bins they can be one real tone's conjugate pair, and over positive bins they can be one off-grid tone's main bin and leakage neighbor.
argument_skeleton.section_bearing: This section changes the consumer interface from an unconditional argmax to a structured candidate-or-reject decision.
argument_skeleton.seam_to_next: The group rule says which coordinates a decision needs; the next step is to identify those coordinates before comparing magnitudes or cost.

argument_skeleton.heading: Feature coordinates must be named before thresholds or cost
argument_skeleton.running_question: Which eight complex values are being measured, and when can two implementations be said to compute the same values?
argument_skeleton.seam_sentence_contract: A correct row/column rule still fails audit if an exact physical frequency is silently replaced by a nearby bin from a different transform length.
argument_skeleton.concrete_entry: For key 5 at f_s=8 kHz and N=205, compute Delta f=39.024390 Hz, bins 20 and 34, their signed hertz/percent offsets, and place C_205(770), X_205[20], X_256[k], and C_205(1336) on separate labeled coordinates.
argument_skeleton.claim: Exact-nominal correlations, N=205 DFT bins, and zero-padded N=256 bins are different evaluations unless their exponent coordinates coincide; coefficient identity and operation comparisons require one shared coordinate set.
required_apparatus: Definition of C_N(f) as the unscaled negative-sign finite-record projection
Coordinate figure showing exact nominal, N=205, and N=256 grids without merging them
Worked-example/problem pair 1
Separate arithmetic ledgers for direct selected complex sums, real-input Goertzel, mixed-radix historical units, and padded radix-2 FFT slots
argument_skeleton.expectation_reversal: Both nearest N=205 key-5 bin centers lie inside the named +/-1.5% intervals, but that geometric fact neither makes them exact nominal coordinates nor proves receiver operation at the tolerance edges.
argument_skeleton.section_bearing: The decision now consumes named mathematical objects, so later thresholds, cost, and validation cannot compare unlike coordinates.
argument_skeleton.seam_to_next: Even perfectly named feature coordinates describe only one finite frame; the receiver's duration decision needs a longer temporal contract.

argument_skeleton.heading: A feature frame cannot certify the duration gate
argument_skeleton.running_question: How can a 25.625 ms spectral frame participate in a profile that distinguishes durations through 23 ms and from 40 ms?
argument_skeleton.seam_sentence_contract: The N=205 frame supplies spectral evidence after 205 samples, but the named operation boundary cannot be satisfied before at least 320 received samples have been observed.
argument_skeleton.concrete_entry: Place the repaired 20 ms, 25 ms, and 45 ms key-5 files on one duration axis: 160 active samples are mandatory non-operation, 200 are gray, and 360 satisfy only the duration gate.
argument_skeleton.claim: Spectral feature extraction and temporal qualification are separate stages: N=205 can feed a state machine, while operation at the named 40 ms boundary requires at least 320 received samples and the 23-40 ms interval remains locally specified.
required_apparatus: Duration-profile figure with <=23 ms non-operation, 23-40 ms gray, and >=40 ms operation side
Pipeline figure that keeps N=205 feature frames separate from a >=320-sample temporal state
Worked-example/problem pair 2
Latency ledger separating received-onset decision time, frame/hop alignment, and the synthetic FIR's 50-sample source-path delay
argument_skeleton.expectation_reversal: A frame that is long enough to produce stable-looking spectral peaks can still be too short to satisfy the selected duration gate; 25 ms is not a mandatory reject merely because it is shorter than 40 ms.
argument_skeleton.section_bearing: The receiver acquires temporal state rather than treating every frame as an independent key decision.
argument_skeleton.seam_to_next: Duration is one gate among several; emitting a key requires the entire set to agree at one decision time.

argument_skeleton.heading: A key is the conjunction of declared gates
argument_skeleton.running_question: Which conditions must be simultaneously true before a candidate pair becomes an emitted key?
argument_skeleton.seam_sentence_contract: Temporal qualification prevents short false registrations, but it cannot repair a missing group, an out-of-profile frequency, failed dominance, or unacceptable twist.
argument_skeleton.concrete_entry: Run four records through a compact decision table under the frozen study threshold table: nominal 45 ms key 5 as an accepted candidate only if every gate passes; the 20 ms file as reject; the 25 ms file as gray/local policy and excluded from conformance denominators; and a lone 770 Hz tone as reject regardless of magnitude.
argument_skeleton.claim: The receiver emits a key only when exactly-one-per-group, frequency, energy/dominance, twist, duration, pause, and interruption gates all pass under one named profile and frozen local threshold table; every other state emits reject or, inside the gray duration region, no conformance label.
required_apparatus: Operational Definition of the gate conjunction and explicit reject output
Decision table separating source/profile values from local receiver thresholds
Frequency operate/non-operation bands kept distinct from Q.23 sender tolerance
The exact frozen receiver-study threshold table, labeled as local design values rather than Q.24 universal values; no retuning from held-out results
argument_skeleton.expectation_reversal: Two individually strong group winners are not sufficient evidence: a detector can pass both argmax operations and still fail frequency, dominance, twist, duration, pause, or interruption.
argument_skeleton.section_bearing: The lesson's central object is now auditable because every route to key, reject, or gray/local policy is explicit.
argument_skeleton.seam_to_next: The frozen gate contract can now be compared with held-out evidence, but each predeclared target keeps its own verdict.

argument_skeleton.heading: Held-out evidence preserves both passes and failures
argument_skeleton.running_question: Which predeclared targets passed on held-out trials, which failed, and what remains outside the synthetic study?
argument_skeleton.seam_sentence_contract: The frozen gate contract makes target-by-target evaluation possible; an honest audit reports the successful clean and hard-set accuracies beside the failed all-negative and 40 ms latency requirements.
argument_skeleton.concrete_entry: Reconstruct the held-out ledger from receiver-study.json: clean is 512/512 (100%); the 10 dB active-tone-SNR, independent +/-1.5% hard subset is 1023/1024 (99.902344%); mandatory negatives are 637/640 rejected (99.531250%, so three false accepts); maximum accepted hard-set received-onset latency is 50 ms. The clean and training maxima are 40 ms, but neither establishes the hard-set <=40 ms target.
argument_skeleton.claim: The frozen synthetic study passes its >=99% clean and >=95% hard-set accuracy targets, fails its all-negative-rejected and accepted-hard-trials-at-most-40-ms targets, and therefore has status complete_targets_partially_met rather than overall conformance.
required_apparatus: Coordinate/arithmetic/latency ledger with no combined unnamed cost
Held-out target table with exact numerators, denominators, percentages, latency origin, and explicit pass/fail verdicts; training values remain visibly separate
Synthetic-artifact idealization gap: no deployed receiver, acoustic recording, clipping, reverberation, speech, echo, or calibrated dBm
Rectangular half-bin/-40 dB failure exposed without choosing a replacement window
argument_skeleton.expectation_reversal: High clean and hard-set accuracy does not erase three negative false accepts or a 50 ms latency maximum; repeatability makes those failures auditable rather than optional.
argument_skeleton.section_bearing: The module closes on an engineering audit whose target-specific claims are no stronger and no weaker than the frozen held-out evidence.
argument_skeleton.exact_closing_handoff: The receiver contract is now auditable: spectral coordinates, named-profile gates, temporal state, latency origins, and arithmetic units are separated, and the frozen held-out study preserves both passed and failed targets. Clean and 10 dB +/-1.5% accuracy targets pass, while all-negative rejection and the 40 ms hard-set latency target fail; the 50 ms maximum cannot be replaced by the 40 ms training or clean value. <Ref lesson="windows-leakage-and-resolution">Windows, Leakage, and Resolution</Ref> next measures how the rectangular record's main lobe and sidelobes hide the weak neighboring line and how a changed window trades that leakage against resolution and calibration.

reversals: Coefficients are not decisions: two largest values can be one tone's conjugate or leakage pair.
A bin center inside a tolerance interval is not an exact-frequency measurement or a receiver-operate proof.
A 205-sample feature frame is not a 320-sample duration qualification.
Two strong group winners are not sufficient when other gates can fail.
Two passed accuracy targets do not turn two failed rejection/latency targets into overall conformance.

body_example_problem_pairs.technique: Keep physical-frequency projections and DFT-grid coordinates distinct before interpreting or costing them.

worked_example.title: key 5 on exact and N=205 coordinates
worked_example.prompt_contract: At f_s=8000 Hz and N=205, compute Delta f, nearest bins for 770 and 1336 Hz, signed hertz and percent offsets, and write both C_205(f) sums beside the corresponding X_205[k] sums. Conclude only that the bin centers lie inside the named +/-1.5% intervals.
worked_example.visible_steps: Show k=round(fN/f_s), f_k=kf_s/N, signed errors, the exponent in each sum, and the limited inference.

parallel_body_problem.prompt_contract: For key 8 (852 and 1336 Hz) at the same f_s and N, produce the same table, then decide whether an N=256 padded FFT coefficient can be declared identical to either exact-nominal C_205(f) without an added interpolation/CZT construction. Write the coordinate condition before opening the solution.
parallel_body_problem.solution_contract: k=22 gives 858.536585 Hz, +6.536585 Hz, +0.767205%; k=34 gives the inherited 1326.829268 Hz and -0.686432%. Ordinary N=256 bins lie at multiples of 31.25 Hz; neither 852 nor 1336 Hz is such a multiple, so the exact-nominal values are not ordinary padded FFT bins. The transferable move is to compare like exponent coordinates before comparing values or work.
parallel_body_problem.fading: The problem supplies the rounding formula but hides the percent calculation and final coordinate judgment.

body_example_problem_pairs.technique: Separate a spectral frame length from a profile's temporal qualification and latency origin.

worked_example.title: three repaired duration fixtures
worked_example.prompt_contract: At 8 kHz, map the 20, 25, and 45 ms active bursts to samples; classify only the duration gate under the named AT&T profile; compare each with N=205 and the 320-sample operation boundary.
worked_example.required_result: 20 ms=160 samples and is mandatory non-operation; 25 ms=200 samples and is gray; 45 ms=360 samples satisfies the duration gate only. N=205 is 25.625 ms and cannot by itself establish the 320-sample/40 ms operation side.
worked_example.visible_steps: Show samples=f_s*T, keep other gates explicitly unevaluated, and separate received-onset timing from the FIR delay.

parallel_body_problem.prompt_contract: Classify 23, 31, and 40 ms bursts and state the earliest evidence span for the duration gate at receiver input. Then add the course FIR's 50-sample delay only to the source-onset ledger, not to the received-onset ledger. Write the three duration regions first.
parallel_body_problem.solution_contract: 23 ms=184 samples is on the mandatory non-operation side; 31 ms=248 samples is gray; 40 ms=320 samples reaches the operation-duration side, assuming all other gates pass. The required received evidence span is 320 samples=40 ms under the declared duration convention. The source-path ledger adds 50 samples=6.25 ms before receiver input, while frame/hop alignment remains a separately declared implementation delay.
parallel_body_problem.fading: The problem supplies the three profile regions but hides all sample counts and the two-origin latency conclusion.

definitions.title: selected-frequency finite-record projection
definitions.placement: Section 2, after the key-5 coordinate computation
definitions.statement_contract: C_N(f)=sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]exp(-j2*pi*f*n/f_s), under the inherited unscaled negative-sign convention.

concept_set.canonical: C_205(770) for the exact nominal low component of key 5
concept_set.structurally_different_valid: X_256[k] written as C_205(kf_s/256) when the 205 samples are followed by 51 zeros and the same exponent coordinate is used
concept_set.boundary: N=1 leaves one sample and a frequency-independent projection x[0]
concept_set.near_miss: Calling C_205(770) equal to X_205[20] violates the exponent-coordinate clause because 770 is not 20f_s/205
concept_set.learner_prompt: Give one physical frequency that is exactly an N=205 bin at 8 kHz and name the equality clause that decides it.

definitions.title: DTMF key-or-reject decision contract
definitions.placement: Section 4, after concrete key/reject/gray records have crossed the decision table
definitions.statement_contract: Emit key(r,c) only when exactly one accepted low-group member r and one accepted high-group member c exist and every declared frequency, energy/dominance, twist, duration, pause, and interruption gate passes; emit reject on any failed/ambiguous gate, while the 23-40 ms profile gap follows an explicitly named local policy rather than a false conformance label.

concept_set.canonical: A nominal 45 ms key-5 pair is a row/column candidate whose other declared gates must still pass
concept_set.structurally_different_valid: A service-key pair such as 941 plus 1209 maps through the same one-low/one-high structure when all gates pass
concept_set.boundary: A 20 ms otherwise-valid pair returns reject; a 25 ms pair has no mandatory duration label under the selected profile
concept_set.near_miss: Two strong low-group tones or one lone 770 Hz tone violate exactly-one-per-group even if two magnitudes exceed local energy thresholds
concept_set.learner_prompt: Construct one input that passes row and column argmax but must still reject; name the first failed gate.

derivations_and_refutations.mode: Short inline derivation, not a theorem: the kernels are identical for every record only when f/f_s is congruent to k/N modulo one. Show equality of the exponent weights; do not overclaim that coincidental equality for one record proves coordinate identity.

Two concrete counterexamples inside an Example: real-signal conjugate symmetry over all bins and lone-tone leakage over positive bins. A separate Proof box would dress a one-record refutation as a general theorem.
Unit-bearing arithmetic in the worked example and ledger, not a theorem. The unresolved sample-boundary/frame-hop convention must remain a declared implementation choice.
Operational Definition plus decision table, not a theorem or proof: Q.24 supplies profile categories/values, while local energy and dominance thresholds are design inputs.

proof_and_definition_boundaries.boundary_verdict: No theorem or Proof environment is pedagogically honest here. The mathematical load is coordinate equality and counterexample reasoning; the central object is an engineering/standards decision definition.

visuals: Section 1: original DTMF frequency grid with key 5 and explicit reject branch
Section 2: exact-nominal versus N=205 versus padded N=256 coordinate ledger
Section 3: duration profile plus spectral-frame/temporal-state pipeline
Section 4: gate conjunction decision table with key/reject/gray outcomes
Section 5: coordinate, operation-unit, latency-origin, and evidence-status ledger
keyfacts: Section 1 synthesis: exactly-one-per-group is necessary but not sufficient; reject is an ordinary output, not an exception.
Section 2 boundary: coefficient equality requires a shared exponent coordinate; proximity or tolerance-band membership is not identity.
Section 3 boundary: 205 samples can supply features but cannot certify a 320-sample duration gate.
Section 4 synthesis: every gate is conjunctive, and the gray duration region is local policy rather than a normative pass/reject claim.
Section 5 evidence boundary: report each frozen held-out target separately; clean and hard accuracy pass, all-negative rejection and hard-set latency fail.
apparatus_plan.callout_deletion_test: Each planned KeyFact adds a boundary or synthesis not supplied by the immediately preceding calculation. If prose already states the same sentence, remove the callout rather than repeat it.
apparatus_plan.fold_policy: Put retrieval answers, complete body-problem solutions, detailed operation ledgers, and the receiver-study reproduction checklist behind folds. Keep the decision mapping, coordinate labels, profile regions, reject branch, latency origins, and target-by-target held-out verdicts visible on the core path.
apparatus_plan.demo: None. The executable study is evidence to audit, not an invitation to add an untethered threshold toy.

keeper_numbers.value: At f_s=8 kHz, N=205 spans 25.625 ms and has 39.024390 Hz bin spacing; key-5 nearest bins are k=20 and k=34.
keeper_numbers.frame: These are spectral-feature coordinates and duration, not proof of tolerance-edge receiver operation.
keeper_numbers.home: Section 2 coordinate figure and section 3 frame/state pipeline

keeper_numbers.value: The named AT&T profile has mandatory non-operation through 23 ms, a 23-40 ms gray region, and operation from 40 ms; at 8 kHz the operation boundary is 320 received samples.
keeper_numbers.frame: The value qualifies only the duration gate and does not supply an overall receiver pass.

keeper_numbers.value: For the fixed N=205 forward fixture, a unit complex line at bin 20.5 leaks -13.46 dB at bin 22, which is 26.54 dB above a -40 dB weak line.
keeper_numbers.frame: This is the rectangular-window failure passed forward; zero padding keeps the 205 observed samples and cannot remove it.
keeper_numbers.home: Section 5 handoff figure and closing exercise 6

items.prompt_contract: For key 5 at f_s=8 kHz and N=205, compute nearest DFT-bin indices, bin-center frequencies, signed hertz offsets, and percent offsets. Return a two-row table and state only whether each bin center lies inside the named +/-1.5% interval.
items.solution_contract: Give k=20 at 780.487805 Hz (+10.487805 Hz, +1.362053%) and k=34 at 1326.829268 Hz (-9.170732 Hz, -0.686432%); both centers lie inside their intervals, but no tolerance-edge receiver operation follows.

items.prompt_contract: Under the named profile, classify <=23 ms, 25 ms, and >=40 ms for the duration gate; then test zero amplitude in one group and a frequency in the open gap between acceptance bands. Separate mandatory reject, gray/local policy, duration-pass-only, and overall reject.
items.solution_contract: <=23 ms is mandatory non-operation; 25 ms is gray; >=40 ms satisfies duration only. A missing group and a gap frequency both fail the key contract and return reject. No case is promoted to full receiver pass without all remaining gates.

items.prompt_contract: Refute 'the largest two FFT bins always name the key' over all bins using real-signal conjugate symmetry and over positive bins using a lone 770 Hz N=205 record. Name the failed inference and replace it with group-specific gates plus reject.
items.solution_contract: Over all bins, +/- frequency partners of one component can be the top two. For the lone 770 Hz record, positive bins k=20 and k=19 are the two largest and both come from one low-group tone. Therefore rank alone cannot establish one low plus one high component.

items.prompt_contract: Using receiver-study.json without retuning any threshold, reconstruct the four predeclared held-out target verdicts. Give numerators, denominators, accuracy percentages, the received-onset latency maximum, and explain why training or clean latency cannot substitute for the hard-set value. Keep gray-duration exclusions and the synthetic idealization gap explicit.
items.solution_contract: Clean is 512/512=100% and passes >=99%; the held-out 10 dB active-tone-SNR, independent +/-1.5% set is 1023/1024=99.902344% and passes >=95%; negatives are 637/640=99.531250%, not all rejected, so that target fails; accepted hard trials reach 50 ms, so <=40 ms fails. The 40 ms maximum belongs to training and clean, and 24-39 ms gray trials are excluded from conformance denominators. Overall status remains complete_targets_partially_met.

items.prompt_contract: Choose and fully specify one apples-to-apples comparison: eight selected N=256 grid sums versus a full N=256 FFT at the same bins, or eight exact-nominal direct correlations versus a noninteger-frequency Goertzel/resonator at the same physical frequencies. State coordinates first, keep arithmetic units separate, and explain why ordinary FFT-grid coefficients cannot be declared identical to exact-nominal outputs.
items.solution_contract: Either branch passes only if both implementations use the same exponent coordinates, sign, scale, and record. The grid branch inherits 1640 selected complex product slots/1632 additions versus the padded FFT's separately named 1024 twiddle slots/2048 additions; the exact branch uses separately reported direct-complex and Goertzel-real ledgers. No universal runtime winner is inferred.

items.kind: E7 forward; the only forward exercise
items.prompt_contract: For a length-205 complex rectangular record, place a unit line at bin coordinate 20.5 and a zero-relative-phase line of amplitude 0.01 at bin 22. Evaluate the strong line's Dirichlet leakage at the weak coordinate, compare it with the weak line, and explain why zero padding alone cannot repair the masking while the observed 205 samples stay fixed.
items.solution_contract: At separation 1.5 bins, normalized strong leakage is 0.212225 or -13.4641 dB; it is 26.5359 dB above the -40 dB weak line. Padding samples the same finite-record DTFT more densely and does not change that kernel. The solution must stop before selecting a window and hand the tradeoff to the next lesson.
items.solution_handoff: State that the next lesson compares main-lobe width, sidelobes, coherent gain, scalloping, and ENBW to choose a window under this failure.

writer_contract.single_objective: Design an auditable DTMF key-or-reject contract; do not expand into window selection, a resonator tutorial, deployed telephony performance, or a claimed receiver implementation.
required_inclusions: Verbatim course opening and the exact three-sentence inheritance throughline
Exactly five content sections in the planned causal order
Exactly two body worked-example/problem pairs with full folded solutions
Exactly six closing exercises with one mechanical item, at least three E6 archetypes, and exactly one forward exercise
Named AT&T Annex A profile every time its exact frequency, twist, duration, pause, or interruption values appear
Explicit reject output and an explicitly local gray-region policy rather than a forced 25 ms conformance label
Separate received-onset and source-onset latency ledgers
Separate exact-nominal, N=205, and N=256 coordinates and separate real, complex, and historical operation units

metrics_withholding_gate.reason: receiver-study.json has status=complete_targets_partially_met and records a frozen executable, hashes, threshold table, splits, denominators, confusion normalization, gray exclusions, and received-onset timing. Its evidence audit supports exact target-specific results even though two performance targets fail.
verified_metrics_allowed: Held-out clean: 512/512=100%, passing the predeclared >=99% target
Held-out 10 dB active-tone-SNR with independent low/high +/-1.5% offsets: 1023/1024=99.902344%, passing the predeclared >=95% target
Mandatory negatives: 637/640=99.531250% rejected with three false accepts, failing the all-rejected target
Accepted hard-set received-onset latency: maximum 50 ms, failing the <=40 ms target
Training and held-out-clean received-onset maxima: 40 ms, usable only when labeled by split and never as the held-out hard-set latency
publication_conditions: Copy exact numerators, denominators, percentages, split names, impairment definition, latency origin, and target verdicts from receiver-study.json
Keep training, held-out clean, held-out hard, mandatory-negative, and gray-excluded records separate
State complete_targets_partially_met and all_declared_targets_met=false wherever an overall verdict is needed
Keep the synthetic FIR/noise study's idealization limits adjacent to the result ledger
Do not retune thresholds, remove false accepts, change denominators, or replace 50 ms with a 40 ms training/clean value
withhold_despite_completed_study: Any percentage, per-class count, confusion cell, latency statistic, runtime, or robustness ranking not directly present in receiver-study.json
Any overall pass, standards-conforming receiver, deployed-telephony, acoustic, speech, echo, clipping, reverberation, calibrated-dBm, or production claim
